title: Chapter 340 Return To Yunshan City
content:
Chapter 340 Return To Yunshan City

It seems that my daughter is doing pretty well.

Lu Daosheng stood in the void and slowly turned his head to look at one place.

In an instant, his eyes penetrated the endless void and looked straight into a hall.

And at this time.

Lu Xue, who was in the hall, suddenly felt something and looked up suddenly in the distance.

For a moment, she seemed to see her father smiling at her.

But when I blinked, I had nothing left.

"Is it an illusion?"

Lu Xue shook her head slightly and continued to deal with her own affairs.

She is really busy now.

At the same time, Lu Daosheng has also left the fairy world.

"System, let's go."

Standing in the starry sky, Lu Daosheng spoke lightly.

But at this moment, he was rarely excited inside.

【Host, please close your eyes】

As Lu Daosheng slowly closed his eyes.

Suddenly, a terrifying suction force sucked him into the unknown space.

Immediately afterwards, he felt his body being torn.

It seemed like he was going to tear him to pieces.

Feeling the strong pain coming from his body, Lu Daosheng suddenly opened his eyes, but it was pitch black and he couldn't see his five fingers.

Gradually, as time passed, the pain finally slowly dissipated.

And Lu Daosheng gradually fell into a deep sleep.

.........

"Brother Sheng, Brother Sheng, wake up, don't scare me."

Feeling that someone was constantly shaking his body desperately, Lu Daosheng finally slowly regained his consciousness and opened his eyes with difficulty.

As soon as I saw a beautiful woman with a pure appearance was crying and looking at her in the rain.

When those big watery eyes saw Lu Daosheng open their eyes, they suddenly felt excited.

"Sheng, Brother Sheng, are you awake?!"

"Who are you?"

Lu Daosheng shook his head suddenly and looked at the woman in front of him with a puzzled look.

At this moment, his head was still a little painful, but with his strong physique, he quickly recovered from his awakening.

At the same time, he also remembered that the system sent him back to Blue Star.

Looking at everything around him, he found himself in a park.

The woman in front of her was wearing a light blue dress, and her whole figure was convex and convex.

"Brother Sheng, do you not recognize me anymore? I am Xiaoxiao, Jiang Xiaoxiao."

Jiang Xiaoxiao looked at Lu Daosheng nervously, afraid that something would go wrong with Lu Daosheng's mind.

Hearing Jiang Xiaoxiao's words, Lu Daosheng was stunned, his eyes suddenly staring at Jiang Xiaoxiao in front of him.

"You, are you really Xiaoxiao?!"

Upon hearing this, Jiang Xiaoxiao nodded suddenly.

"Brother Sheng, you finally remembered it. I thought you were stupid after not seeing each other for eight years."

Eight years. .

Lu Daosheng was a little dazed.

I have been away from here for so long, but it has only been eight years since I have passed?

As we all know, the time flow rate of Blue Star is always different from that of other worlds.

At this time, Lu Daosheng looked at Jiang Xiaoxiao in front of him again.

According to his memory, when he was taken away by the system, Jiang Xiaoxiao was only fourteen years old.

Now, eight years have passed, and Jiang Xiaoxiao has no longer had her original immaturity.

Memories deep in my heart began to pour in my heart.

Yunshan City, Jiang Xiaoxiao, Mr. Jiang.

"Xiaoxiao, old man,"

After Lu Daosheng stood up and came to his senses, he looked at Jiang Xiaoxiao with some concern.

Hearing Lu Daosheng's question, Jiang Xiaoxiao lowered her head slightly and started to thrust again.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng's eyes were slightly red.

A breath slowly overflowed from Lu Daosheng's body, and the wind suddenly blew up and the sky began to be covered with dark clouds.

Feeling the changes around him, Jiang Xiaoxiao was stunned and quickly got up and pulled Lu Daosheng up.

"Brother Sheng, let's talk about it when we get home. It's going to rain."

Lu Daosheng:...

This park is the park below the community where Jiang Xiaoxiao lives.

So in just a moment, Jiang Xiaoxiao took Lu Daosheng back home.

"Brother Sheng, you sit down first. I'll make a glass of water for you. I have many questions to ask you."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng was not polite and sat on the sofa.

A slightly low voice came from Lu Daosheng's mouth.

“I have a lot of questions to ask you.”

His return this time just can make up for many of the regrets he had back then.

At the same time, it is also to repay Mr. Jiang’s kindness.

He is an orphan, and it was Mr. Jiang who adopted him and raised him.

With this alone, Lu Daosheng had no reason not to repay his kindness.

But I didn't expect that eight years have passed, Mr. Jiang has already,

well.

Thinking of this, Lu Daosheng looked dim and sighed slightly.

It's because I'm late.

Fortunately, Mr. Jiang’s granddaughter Jiang Xiaoxiao is still there.

The Jiang family was once glorious before and was one of the best families in Yunshan City, but it fell later.

Now, since he is back, let the Jiang family rise again.

He, Lu Daosheng, has this strength.

Feeling the power in his body, Lu Daosheng's expression remained unchanged.

Weak, he is simply weak compared to the past.

I think it was the system that helped him suppress the power in his body.

However, on Blue Star, he is still at the top.

After a moment of silence, Lu Daosheng called out in his heart.

"system?"

However, the familiar system sound has no response.

At this time, a cup of hot tea fell on the coffee table in front of Lu Daosheng.

"Brother Sheng, give it."

Jiang Xiaoxiao sat directly next to Lu Daosheng.

Lu Daosheng was not polite about this.

Pick up the teacup and drink it all in one go.

On the side, Jiang Xiaoxiao opened her mouth wide and looked at Lu Daosheng blankly.

"Sheng, Brother Sheng, that's boiling water. Are you not afraid of burning?"

But Lu Daosheng didn't care.

Seeing that Lu Daosheng didn't say anything, Jiang Xiaoxiao curled her lips and said directly: "Brother Sheng, where have you been in the past eight years? Do you know that grandpa and I are worried about you?"

Jiang Xiaoxiao looked at Lu Daosheng with a little blame.

They even thought that Lu Daosheng had encountered something unexpected.

But they searched all over Yunshan City, and even the surrounding areas, but still found no clues about Lu Daosheng.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng was silent for a moment and said, "I was taken to a very special place and learned some skills there. Because that place is very special, I didn't tell you."

The reason why Lu Daosheng said this is to give excuses when he demonstrates his abilities in the future.

Otherwise, he will slap a large piece to death in the future. What should I say?

Is superpower awakening?

However, when Jiang Xiaoxiao heard Lu Daosheng's words, her expression became strange.

After hesitating for a moment, Jiang Xiaoxiao tentatively said, "Brother Sheng, have you entered the pyramid scheme?"

Lu Daosheng:...

I don’t know how many times this is Lu Daosheng’s speechless.

At this moment, he had to sigh that he seemed to be out of place with Blue Star's life over the years.
